title: Square-zero flat module liftability under a flat formal-neighbourhood comparison
statement: Let $A'\twoheadrightarrow A$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with square-zero kernel $I$ (that is, $I^2=0$). Let $A'\to S'\to T'$ be flat homomorphisms of commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Put $S=S'\otimes_{A'}A=S'/IS'$ and $T=T'\otimes_{A'}A=T'/IT'$, with their induced maps $A\to S\to T$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Let $K'\subseteq S'$ be an ideal for which the canonical map $S'/K'\to T'/K'T'$ is an isomorphism. Let $M$ be a finitely generated $S$-module (there are finitely many elements whose $S$-linear combinations exhaust $M$) that is flat over $A$. For $g\in S'$, write $S'_g=S'[1/g]$, $S_g=S[1/\bar g]$, and $M_g=M\otimes_S S_g$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Suppose that for every $g\in K'$ there is an $A'$-flat $S'_g$-module $L_g$ with a specified $S_g$-linear isomorphism $L_g\otimes_{A'}A\cong M_g$. Then there exists an $A'$-flat $S'$-module $L$ with an $S$-linear isomorphism $L\otimes_{A'}A\cong M$ if and only if there exists an $A'$-flat $T'$-module $N$ with a $T$-linear isomorphism $N\otimes_{A'}A\cong M\otimes_S T$.

source.place: Tag 0DZ2, lemma-lift-equivalence-module, square-zero-kernel part of its proof, with M finite. The displayed nilpotent-kernel statement and its omitted induction are false in general (see report.md, Source error); only the square-zero obstruction argument is used here. Scalar-extension squares are S=S′⊗_{A′}A and T=T′⊗_{A′}A.

proof.text: Put $J=IS'$, $J_T=IT'$ and let $K\subset S$ be the image of $K'$. Tensor associativity gives $T=S\otimes_{S'}T'$ and $A\to S\to T$ flat: for an injection of modules over the source, tensor first with the relevant flat algebra and use the tensor cancellation isomorphism. The same argument gives $A'\to T'$ flat and $M_T=M\otimes_ST$ flat over $A$. The isomorphism $S'/K'\cong T'/K'T'$ carries the ideal generated by the image of $I$ to its counterpart; quotienting by these ideals gives $S/K\cong T/KT$. Noetherianity makes $K$ finitely generated. Localization at any $g\in K'$ is flat by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-flat]; the tensor cancellation argument also makes $S'_g$ flat over $A'$ and $M_g$ flat over $A$.

source.place: Tag 0DZ2, lemma-lift-equivalence-module, square-zero part of the proof.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-flat-module-derived-lift-criterion] to $P'=S'$. The square-zero assertion identifies $M\otimes_S^{\mathbf L}J$ with $B[0]$, where $B=M\otimes_A I$. Thus [lem-sfb-square-zero-complex-obstruction] gives a class $w=\omega_{S'/S}(M)\in E:=\operatorname{Hom}_{D(S)}(M[0],B[2])$. Its vanishing is equivalent first to a bounded-above derived lift and then to an $A'$-flat $S'$-module lift of $M$. The same two lemmas apply to $P'=T'$ and to every $P'=S'_g$, by Step 1. In particular their corresponding classes vanish exactly when the respective module lifts exist. All reduction isomorphisms here are the prescribed module-linear ones, since $L\otimes_{S'}S=L\otimes_{A'}A$.

source.place: Tag 0DZ2, lemma-lift-equivalence-module, square-zero part of the proof.

proof.text:
Since $S$ is Noetherian and $M$ is finite, [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-pseudocoherent-cohomology-criterion] makes $M[0]$ pseudo-coherent. Apply [lem-trf-pseudocoherent-rhom-flat-base-change] with first object $M[0]$, second object $B[0]\in D^+(S)$, and flat scalar extension $S\to T$ (or $S\to S_g$). Taking $H^2$ commutes with the flat tensor by [lem-trf-flat-projective-hom-models]. It gives the canonical identifications
$$E\otimes_ST\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(T)}(M_T[0],(B\otimes_ST)[2]),\qquad E_{\bar g}\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(S_g)}(M_g[0],B_g[2]).$$
Tensor associativity gives $B\otimes_ST=M_T\otimes_A I$ and $B_g=M_g\otimes_A I$. The flat base-change clause of [lem-sfb-square-zero-complex-obstruction], for $S'\to T'$ and $S'\to S'_g$, therefore identifies the respective obstruction classes with $w\otimes1$ and $w/1$. The identifications of kernel modules are multiplication maps $J\otimes_ST\to J_T$ and $J\otimes_SS_g\to J_g$, exactly those in that clause.

source.place: Tag 0DZ2, lemma-lift-equivalence-module, square-zero part of the proof.

proof.text: By hypothesis every $M_g$ has a flat lift, so Steps 2–3 show $w/1=0$ in $E_{\bar g}$ for all $g\in K'$. Choose generators $g_1,\ldots,g_t$ of $K'$; their images generate $K$. The definition of localization gives integers $n_i\ge1$ with $\bar g_i^{n_i}w=0$. Every monomial of degree $n=1+\sum_i(n_i-1)$ in these generators contains some $\bar g_i^{n_i}$; hence $K^nw=0$. If $K'=0$, then $K=0$ and $Kw=0$ directly. Thus $w\in E[K^\infty]$ without any assertion that the entire module $E$ has this support.

source.place: Tag 0DZ2, lemma-lift-equivalence-module, square-zero part of the proof.

proof.text: The hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-torsion-submodule-flat-base-change-iso] hold for $S\to T$ and the finitely generated ideal $K$, by Step 1. Consequently $E[K^\infty]\to(E\otimes_ST)[(KT)^\infty]$, $e\mapsto e\otimes1$, is injective (indeed bijective). Step 4 puts $w$ in its domain, so $w=0$ if and only if $w\otimes1=0$. By Step 3 the latter is exactly the obstruction to lifting $M_T$; Step 2 translates both vanishings into the two flat module liftability assertions. This proves both implications, without descending a chosen $T'$-module or invoking an induction on a general nilpotent kernel.
